Remark
[Lichnerowicz eigenvalue estimate]

Source: petersen:page-0324 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-cheng-rigidity 1. ch7:7.5.15Let $(M^n,g)$ be closed with $\Ric \ge (n-1)k>0$. Use the Bochner formula to show that every $u$ with $\Delta u=-\lambda u$, $\lambda >0$, satisfies $\lambda \ge nk$. Deduce, via the spectral theorem for $\Delta $, that every $u$ with $\int u\, \vol =0$ satisfies the Poincaré inequality $\int u^2\, \vol \le \tfrac 1{nk}\int |du|^2\, \vol $.
